title: Private Group Soda Firing
source_quote: Soda gas firing: 12 participants, $195 per person. Includes glazes, flashing slips, wadding, soda, wood, and related firing materials.
evidence_sentence: Studios or schools can book private soda-gas or hybrid wood-soda firings for groups (12 or 24 participants) with all materials included.
evidence_quote: Soda gas firing: 12 participants, $195 per person.
summary: Studios or schools can book a private soda gas firing for 12 participants ($195 each) or cover minimum for smaller groups. All glazes, slips, wadding, and materials included. BBQ grill provided.
how_to_join: Submit inquiry form on the private firings page
pay_text: $195 per participant; studio-owner bookings receive $200 credit
